en.title: DHHS Updates Accessibility Rules, Impacting Healthcare Compliance Nationwide
en.summary: The Department of Health and Human Services revised its accessibility regulations, potentially altering compliance risks for hospitals and providers nationwide. Additionally, an all-terrain wheelchair expanded access to Sammamish State Park, Missouri launched its first mobile accessibility center, and a University of Phoenix survey highlighted AI's role in improving work and learning accessibility. Finally, reports detailed ongoing human rights violations against people with disabilities in Miyagi Prefecture, Japan.

zh-TW.title: 衛生部更新無障礙規則，影響醫療合規與多項無障礙進展
zh-TW.summary: 衛生及公共服務部更新無障礙規則，可能降低或增加醫療機構的合規風險。全地形輪椅擴大了薩ammamish州立公園的無障礙使用，密蘇里州首輛流動無障礙中心啟動，鳳凰大學調查指出AI有潛力提升工作與學習無障礙。此外，令和新選組在推動國會無障礙方面的立法努力受到關注。
